Command.Name: cmdExportMenu
Command.TooltipDescription: Export a copy as PDF, Word or OpenDocument; the document itself stays as it is.

Command.Name: cmdPrintMenu
Command.TooltipDescription: Print, preview and set up the page.

Command.Name: cmdNew
Command.TooltipDescription: Start a new, empty document.

Command.Name: cmdOpen
Command.TooltipDescription: Open a document: HTML, Markdown, RTF, Word, OpenDocument or text.

Command.Name: cmdSave
Command.TooltipDescription: Save the document.

Command.Name: cmdSaveAs
Command.TooltipDescription: Save the document under a new name or in another format.

Command.Name: cmdPrint
Command.TooltipDescription: Print the document.

Command.Name: cmdPrintPreview
Command.TooltipDescription: See the pages as they will be printed.

Command.Name: cmdPageSetup
Command.TooltipDescription: Paper size, orientation and margins.

Command.Name: cmdExportPdf
Command.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as PDF (through Microsoft Print to PDF).

Command.Name: cmdExportWord
Command.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as a Word document.

Command.Name: cmdExportOdt
Command.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as an OpenDocument text file.

Command.Name: cmdExit
Command.TooltipDescription: Close AhkWord.

Command.Name: cmdNewFromTemplate
Command.TooltipDescription: Start a new document from a template (letter, memo, report, court paper ... or your own), filling in its fields.

Command.Name: cmdNewWindow
Command.TooltipDescription: Open another AhkWord window, with a new document, to work on two documents at once.

Command.Name: cmdOpenInNewWindow
Command.TooltipDescription: Open a document in another AhkWord window, keeping this one as it is.

Command.Name: cmdStartPage
Command.TooltipDescription: The start page: a blank document, the templates, the recent documents and the macros (it can also be shown at the start).

Command.Name: cmdInsertFromTemplate
Command.TooltipDescription: Insert a template's content at the caret (a caption, a signature block, a certificate of service ...), filling in its fields.

Command.Name: cmdFillInFields
Command.TooltipDescription: Fill in the {{fields}} left in the document, as a template's are filled in (with the values typed last time).

Command.Name: cmdClose
Command.TooltipDescription: Close the document (asking to save its changes) and start an empty one; the window stays open.

Command.Name: cmdPaste
Command.TooltipDescription: Paste the contents of the clipboard.

Command.Name: cmdCut
Command.TooltipDescription: Cut the selection to the clipboard.

Command.Name: cmdCopy
Command.TooltipDescription: Copy the selection to the clipboard.

Command.Name: cmdFind
Command.TooltipDescription: Find text. F3 finds the next match.

Command.Name: cmdReplace
Command.TooltipDescription: Find text and replace it.

Command.Name: cmdFontDialog
Command.TooltipDescription: More font options.

Command.Name: cmdChangeCase
Command.TooltipDescription: UPPER CASE, lower case or Title Case.

Command.Name: cmdUnderlineStyle
Command.TooltipDescription: Single, double, dotted, dashed or wavy underline.

Command.Name: cmdBullets
Command.TooltipDescription: Start or end a bulleted list.

Command.Name: cmdNumbering
Command.TooltipDescription: Start or end a numbered list. Tab and Shift+Tab change the level.

Command.Name: cmdLegal
Command.TooltipDescription: Number list items 1., 1.1, 1.1.1 by level.

Command.Name: cmdOutdent
Command.TooltipDescription: Shift+Tab in a list.

Command.Name: cmdIndent
Command.TooltipDescription: Tab in a list.

Command.Name: cmdLineSpacing
Command.TooltipDescription: The line spacing of the selected paragraphs: 1.0, 1.15, 1.5, 2.0 ... lines, or exactly or at least so many points (Line Spacing Options).

Command.Name: cmdLineSpacingOptions
Command.TooltipDescription: The Paragraph dialog: line spacing, the space before and after, indents, and the line and page breaks.

Command.Name: cmdParagraphDialog
Command.TooltipDescription: Alignment, indents, spacing, line spacing, line and page breaks (keep with next, keep lines together, widow and orphan control, page break before), and tabs, for the selected paragraphs.

Command.Name: cmdSpaceBefore
Command.TooltipDescription: 12 points before the selected paragraphs (checked: they have space before; click to remove it).

Command.Name: cmdSpaceAfter
Command.TooltipDescription: 12 points after the selected paragraphs (checked: they have space after; click to remove it).

Command.Name: cmdListOptions
Command.TooltipDescription: List styles, list levels (the numbering style of each level), restarting and continuing numbering.

Command.Name: cmdListNone
Command.TooltipDescription: The selected paragraphs are no longer list items: their numbers or bullets go, their text stays.

Command.Name: cmdListLevels
Command.TooltipDescription: Each level's numbering style, punctuation, start number, and where its number and text start (Tab and Shift+Tab change an item's level).

Command.Name: cmdConvertTyped
Command.TooltipDescription: Paragraphs that start with typed numbers such as "1.", "a)" or "(iv)" become list items.

Command.Name: cmdNumberingMenu
Command.TooltipDescription: Start or end a numbered list. The arrow: numbering styles and list levels.

Command.Name: cmdBlockStyle
Command.TooltipTitle: Paragraph style (Ctrl+0 Normal, Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+6 headings, Ctrl+7 Code)
Command.TooltipDescription: The style of the paragraphs the selection is in: Normal, Title, the headings, Quote, Code and your own (the Styles menu changes them).

Command.Name: cmdStylesMenu
Command.TooltipDescription: Change a style, make a new one from the paragraph at the caret, choose a style set, or keep the styles as your default for new documents.

Command.Name: cmdModifyStyle
Command.TooltipDescription: Change the style of the paragraph at the caret (font, spacing, indents ...); every paragraph with it changes too.

Command.Name: cmdNewStyle
Command.TooltipDescription: A new style, from the paragraph at the caret, given to it.

Command.Name: cmdUpdateStyle
Command.TooltipDescription: Make the caret paragraph's style look like the paragraph (format one paragraph as wanted, then this); every paragraph with the style changes too.

Command.Name: cmdClearFormatting
Command.TooltipDescription: The selected text back to its paragraph's style (formatting of its own goes); with no selection, the whole paragraph, its spacing and indents too.

Command.Name: cmdDeleteStyle
Command.TooltipDescription: Delete a style of your own; its paragraphs become Normal.

Command.Name: cmdStyleSetClassic
Command.TooltipDescription: Times New Roman 12, black headings: court papers, contracts, letters.

Command.Name: cmdStyleSetPlain
Command.TooltipDescription: Segoe UI 11, bold headings: the editor's look before styles.

Command.Name: cmdStyleSetModern
Command.TooltipDescription: Georgia text with Segoe UI headings in dark grey, a little more air between lines.

Command.Name: cmdSaveStyles
Command.TooltipDescription: New documents get this document's styles (your changes included).

Command.Name: cmdCopyStyles
Command.TooltipDescription: Bring styles from another document (AhkWord's, Word's, RTF) into this one, and into your defaults for new documents if you like: choose which.

Command.Name: cmdApplyMyStyles
Command.TooltipDescription: Give this document your styles (the ones new documents get): its headings, Normal text and other styles take your look; formatting of a paragraph's own stays.

Command.Name: cmdPageBreak
Command.TooltipDescription: Start a new page here.

Command.Name: cmdTable
Command.TooltipDescription: Insert a table.

Command.Name: cmdPicture
Command.TooltipDescription: Insert a picture from a file.

Command.Name: cmdThumbnail
Command.TooltipDescription: A small picture that links to the full-size picture.

Command.Name: cmdCrossReference
Command.TooltipDescription: Refer to a numbered paragraph ("see paragraph 3(b)"): the number follows the paragraph's when the paragraphs are renumbered. Ctrl+click it to go there.

Command.Name: cmdFootnote
Command.TooltipDescription: A numbered note at the foot of the page. With the caret on a footnote's number: change its note.

Command.Name: cmdUpdateReferences
Command.TooltipDescription: Brings every cross-reference's number up to date. Done by itself as paragraphs are renumbered, and before saving and printing.

Command.Name: cmdLink
Command.TooltipDescription: Insert a link to a web page or file.

Command.Name: cmdHeaderFooter
Command.TooltipDescription: The document's header and footer, with page numbers and dates.

Command.Name: cmdNextSpelling
Command.TooltipDescription: Go to the next misspelled word. Right-click it for suggestions.

Command.Name: cmdAddToDictionary
Command.TooltipDescription: Add the selected word to the Windows dictionary.

Command.Name: cmdWordWrap
Command.TooltipDescription: Without Print Layout: lines wrap at the window's edge (unchecked: they don't wrap at all, and the window scrolls sideways). With Print Layout, lines break as on the printed page, so this waits until Print Layout is off.

Command.Name: cmdPrintLayout
Command.TooltipDescription: Lines break where they will on the printed page (Page Setup's paper and margins), as in Word and LibreOffice, with the page shown on grey. Off: lines wrap at the window's edge.

Command.Name: cmdShowPages
Command.TooltipDescription: Print Layout: each printed page as a sheet of its own, with its header and footer in its margins, as in Word. A preview, not reliable while typing yet: the view can shift. Off: one long page, with a line where each page begins.

Command.Name: cmdZoomPageWidth
Command.TooltipDescription: Zoom so that the page's width fills the window, as the window is resized too (Print Layout).

Command.Name: cmdZoomOnePage
Command.TooltipDescription: Zoom so that a whole page's height fits in the window (Print Layout).

Command.Name: cmdExportPdfButton
Command.TooltipDescription: Save a copy as PDF, laid out as it prints (through Microsoft Print to PDF; the default printer stays as it is).

Command.Name: cmdZoomMultiplePages
Command.TooltipDescription: The printed pages side by side, as many as fit (read-only; Zoom In and Out, or Ctrl+wheel, show them larger or smaller). Double-click a page to edit it there; Esc goes back.

Command.Name: cmdViewRich
Command.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as formatted text.

Command.Name: cmdViewMarkdown
Command.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as Markdown. Saving a .md file writes your Markdown exactly as typed.

Command.Name: cmdViewHtml
Command.TooltipDescription: Edit the document as HTML. Tags and styles the editor doesn't support are dropped when the formatted view is rebuilt.

Command.Name: cmdSideBySide
Command.TooltipDescription: The Markdown or HTML next to the formatted text, which follows as you type.

Command.Name: cmdMacros
Command.TooltipDescription: Run an AHK script from the rte_macros folder.

Command.Name: cmdRecordMacro
Command.TooltipDescription: Record typing and commands as an AHK script. Mouse clicks are not recorded.

Command.Name: cmdMacroHotkeys
Command.TooltipDescription: Give macros hotkeys that work while the editor is active.

Command.Name: cmdRunScript
Command.TooltipDescription: Run any AHK script against this editor.

Command.Name: cmdAutomationApi
Command.TooltipDescription: What AHK scripts can call (RteClient2.ahk: Rte.<Name>(...)).

Command.Name: cmdTableProperties
Command.TooltipDescription: Column widths, borders, shading, row height, alignment and cell padding.

Command.Name: cmdTableBorders
Command.TooltipDescription: Lines around and between the selected cells (or the whole table, if it is selected).

Command.Name: cmdTableShading
Command.TooltipDescription: The background color of the selected cells.

Command.Name: cmdLineNumbers
Command.TooltipDescription: Number the lines in the left margin, as in Word: continuously or restarting on each page. Lines in tables don't count.

Command.Name: cmdSuppressLineNumbers
Command.TooltipDescription: The selected paragraphs' lines get no numbers and are not counted.

Command.Name: cmdLineNumberOptions
Command.TooltipDescription: The first number, the distance from the text, and which numbers are shown (every line's, or every 5th ...).
